name: Mercury Dragon, Adult
body:
ADULT MERCURY DRAGON
CR 10

XP 9,600
CG Large dragon (fire)
Init +1; Senses dragon senses, Perception +19
Aura frightful presence (180 ft., DC 16)

DEFENSE

AC 26, touch 9, flat-footed 26 (+17 natural, -1 size)
hp 149 (13d12+65)
Fort +13, Ref +10, Will +11; +3 racial vs. light or pattern effects
DR 5/magic; Immune blindness, dazzle, fire, paralysis, sleep; SR 21
Weaknesses vulnerability to cold

OFFENSE

Speed 60 ft., fly 200 ft. (average), graceful flight
Melee bite +19 (2d6+10), 2 claws +19 (1d8+7), 2 wings +17 (1d6+3), tail slap +17 (1d8+10)
Space 10 ft., Reach 5 ft. (10 ft. with bite)
Special Attacks breath weapon (80-ft. line, 12d6 fire), brilliance (180 ft. beam or 360 ft. cone, DC 16)
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 13th, concentration +16)

At will—gaze screen (DC 15), mirror image

Spells Known (CL 7th, concentration +10)

3rd (5/day)—claraudience/clarvoyance, daylight
2nd (7/day)—blindness/deafness (DC 15), burst of radiance (DC 15), daze monster (DC 15)
1st (7/day)—alarm, blurred movement, color spray (DC 14), magic missile, protection from evil
0th (at will)—dancing lights, daze (DC 13), detect magic, flare (DC 13), light, prestidigitation, spark

STATISTICS

Str 25, Dex 10, Con 21, Int 16, Wis 17, Cha 16
Base Atk +13; CMB +21; CMD 31 (34 vs. trip)
Feats Acrobatic, Flyby Attack, Hover, Lightning Reflexes, Multiattack, Solar Spell, Wingover
Skills Acrobatics +17/+20, Appraise +19, Climb +23, Fly +18, Knowledge (arcana, nature) +19, Perception +19, Sense Motive +19, Spellcraft +19; Racial Modifiers +3 on Acrobatics skill checks to jump
Languages Common, Draconic, Ignan, Underground Common
SQ change shape (any humanoid or animal form, 3/day, polymorph)

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Breath Weapon (Su)

A mercury dragon’s breath weapon is a line of intense light that burns whatever it touches, dealing fire damage.

Brilliance (Ex)

As a standard action, a mercury dragon can use the mirror-bright membranes of its wings to reflect and concentrate available light into a beam of dazzling brightness. To use this power, the dragon needs light as bright as an overcast day or clear, moonlight night.

Torchlight or candle light is insufficient.

The power creates a thin beam the dragon can aim at a single target within 30 feet per age category of the dragon. The target is blinded for 1d4+1 rounds unless it makes a Reflex save (DC 10 + ½ the dragon’s Hit Dice, + the dragon’s Dexterity modifier). If not using this technique as a weapon, the dragon can create a cone of light as bright as a daylight spell up to 60 feet long per age category of the dragon. The cone lasts 3 rounds.

Change Shape (Su)

An adult or older mercury dragon can assume any animal or humanoid form 3/day as if using polymorph.

Compression (Ex)

A mercury dragon can move through an area as small as one-quarter its space without squeezing or one-eighth its space when squeezing.

Graceful Flight (Ex)

A young adult or older mercury dragon’s aerial maneuverability is one step better than normal.

High Jump (Ex)

A very young or older mercury dragon receives a racial bonus equal to its age category on Acrobatics skill checks made to jump.

Mercurial Shape (Sp)

A great wyrm mercury dragon can assume a semi-solid form at will, as ooze form III.

Protected Sight (Ex)

A young or older mercury dragon is immune to any effect that would blind or dazzle it. It also gains +3 racial bonus on saving throws against any light or pattern effects.

Spell-Like Abilities (Sp)

A mercury dragon gains the following spell-like abilities, usable at will upon reaching the listed age category.

ECOLOGY

Environment temperate and warm mountains and underground
Organization solitary
Treasure triple

A mercury dragon is considered a true (metallic) dragon for the purpose of a sorcerer or bloodrager with the draconic bloodline, an oracle with the Dragon mystery, a shaman with the Dragon spirit, the Draconic Heritage and Draconic Manifestation feats, and similar effects. Its energy type is fire, and the granted breath weapon is a 60-foot line. A character using form of the dragon to transform into a mercury dragon gains the following abilities: 60-foot line of fire, resist fire 20, +4 bonus on saving throws against blinding, dazzling, or light and pattern effects, and vulnerability to cold.
